title: Small values of Erdős problems (#600, #642, #934, #983) and even-cycle-free extremal audit (A032766 vs A380408): data, solvers, and Lean 4 proofs
description: Exact small-n values, explicit combinatorial witnesses, exact solvers (C canonical enumeration, OR-Tools CP-SAT, Z3 CEGAR, pure Python), and standalone Lean 4 proofs for problems from erdosproblems.com aligned with google-deepmind/formal-conjectures: #600 (n <= 14), #642 (n <= 9), #934 (t = 2), #983 (n <= 46), plus a formal Lean 4 audit of even-cycle-free extremal edge counts (OEIS A032766) disambiguated from OEIS A380408 and Erdős #151.
